name: Reservation
description: Reservation National Park, located in Kurunagala, Sri Lanka, offers visitors a chance to observe diverse wildlife through guided hikes and nature trails. Established as a conservation area to protect local flora and fauna, the park attracts nature enthusiasts and wildlife watchers from across the country. Historically, the land was part of ancient royal hunting grounds, but the modern park was officially inaugurated in 2010 by the then President. Visitors can explore the park's various ecosystems, including wetlands and grasslands, while keeping an eye out for the region's unique bird species and other native wildlife.
